# openmetadata_ai_governance_policy Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata AI governance policy by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_ai_governance_policy" "bias_review" {
  fully_qualified_name = "bias-review"
}

output "bias_review_policy_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_ai_governance_policy.bias_review.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Policy fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Policy UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is active.
- `enforcement_level` (String) How strictly the policy is enforced: Advisory, Warning or Blocking.
- `name` (String) Policy name.
- `policy_type` (String) Policy category such as BiasThreshold or DataAccess.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
